item.title: ‘Not good for the game’- Salman Ali Agha says Pakistan was not hurt by handshake refusal by Team India in Asia Cup 2025
item.description: Pakistan captain Salman Ali Agha has revealed that the team was not particularly hurt by the Indian team’s decision not to shake hands with them during the Asia Cup 2025 tournament. But he did say that such behavior was not good for the game of cricket. The Asia Cup 2025 happened months after the Pahalgam terrorist attack that claimed multiple lives. item.title: Harshit Rana confirmed to miss T20 World Cup 2026 due to knee injury; BCCI names Mohammed Siraj as replacement
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), on February 6, 2026, confirmed that Delhi pacer Harshit Rana will miss the upcoming ICC T20 World Cup 2026 that begins on February 7. item.title: “I can perform in big games”: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi silences critics after match-winning 175 in U19 World Cup final
item.description: India’s teenage batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi took the cricketing world by storm as he smashed a blistering 175 off 80 balls in the ICC U19 World Cup 2026 final in Harare on Friday (February 6). Sooryavanshi’s knock, studded with 15 fours and 15 sixes, propelled India to a gigantic total of 411/9. item.title: BCCI announces whopping cash reward for India’s U-19 team after World Cup win
item.description: The Board of Control for India (BCCI) announced a whopping cash reward for the Indian U19 cricket team after they clinched the ICC U19 World Cup 2026 title by defeating England in the final at Harare Sports Club on Friday (February 6). BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia expressed pride in India U19 team’s unbeaten campaign. He announced a cash prize of Rs 7.5 crore for the Ayush Mhatre-led side.
